description: Global Precipitation Measurement - Precipitation and Applications Viewer is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NASA Precipitation Measurement Missions; University of Maryland. View and download various precipitation datasets from the past 60 days. Datasets are available in a range of popular formats, TIF, SHP, arcJSON, geoJSON, and topoJSON. Users can also learn how to directly access the data via the PMM Publisher API. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Critical Facilities, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
